visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair wearing a black t-shirt and a woman with short hair, glasses, and a tan blazer sit in a studio setting. The background is a grey pleated curtain. The man holds a black compact in his hands while speaking. (2) A static image of a white sunscreen tube labeled 'DRX' appears in the center, overlapping the speakers. The man continues to gesture with the compact. (3) The sunscreen image is replaced by a black cushion compact with 'KAI BEAUTY' text. The speakers are visible in the background, looking at the product. (4) The camera returns to a medium shot of the two individuals. The woman is now holding the DRX sunscreen tube, pointing to it as she explains something to the man. (5) A close-up shot of the woman focusing on her facial expressions as she speaks emphatically. She holds the sunscreen tube near her chest. (6) A close-up shot of the man, looking skeptical or curious, tilting his head slightly while listening to the woman's explanation. (7) The camera cuts back to the woman who holds the cushion compact up, demonstrating its size compared to the sunscreen. She gestures with her other hand to emphasize a point. (8) The screen transitions to a white background with a dark logo and the text '達特仕保養品 DRX Series Skincare' appearing as a final graphic.

The background is acoustically clean with no environmental noise. (2) A female voice enters with high confidence and professional clarity, responding to the male speaker. The BGM continues steadily. (3) The male voice asks a specific question about SPF 50; the tempo of his speech is moderate. (4) The female voice responds emphatically with 'Not enough, not enough,' marked by a slight increase in volume and pitch. A 'pop' SFX punctuates the emphasis. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to debunk a common skincare misconception that makeup compacts with SPF provide sufficient sun protection. Dr. Chuang uses mathematical logic (the amount of product needed vs. the total weight of the compact) to explain why users still need a dedicated sunscreen, effectively promoting the DRX sunscreen as the necessary base layer.
